title: Gilgamesh Mission-Contract v1
description: The typed mission Gilgamesh CONSUMES inbound (ECL artifact.kind 'mission-contract') from the orchestrator or a human. Gauge validates this contract before any work begins; a mission that maps cleanly to a specialist, or that requests authority beyond the grantable ceiling, is REFUSED cheaply. Named consistently with the eidolons-ecl per-eidolon schema authored in parallel (Track F).

evidence_required.description: The external evidence format that will prove each deliverable — the oracle set Gilgamesh binds acceptance signals to in Lock.

authority.description: The six-row authority grant. Instantiates the capability-authority table's default column; deploy is never grantable regardless of what the contract requests.
